correctness.rationale: For n>=2 all selected off-diagonal orbit edges lift as a two-sheet cover of a base graph; cycles lift to cycles, while each base tree lifts as two disjoint copies. A fixed diagonal edge connects those two copies and a second in the same component creates precisely a cycle. Thus admissible orbit subsets are exactly forests of K_{n+1}. The affine orbit-barycenter map is a genuine PL homeomorphism. Standard matroid shellability gives integer homology in one degree, and Lefschetz plus rational transfer gives the trace and quotient. Exact all-subsets enumeration n<=5 and independent oriented-simplex traces n<=4 corroborate but do not replace the universal proof.

value.rationale: This exact equivariant PL reduction turns a natural side-exchange fixed locus of a balanced biclique forest matroid into a complete-graph graphic matroid for every n, collapsing the top dimension from 2n-2 to n-1. It determines all integral fixed-space homology and, via its Euler characteristic, the rational plus/minus split and quotient homology of a natural ambient involution for all orders, beyond an isolated Euler-characteristic computation. Its exact integer counts 1,6,51,560 are consequences of the structural theorem rather than the primary claim.
